baseline.scope: Each swapped actor has valid enemy-player HP hits and changed-teammate membership in an exact successful team strike or positive retreat cover. Co-present allies need not also act; no regroup, survival contribution or winner causality acceptance.

candidate.scope: Each swapped actor has valid enemy-player HP hits and changed-teammate membership in an exact successful team strike or positive retreat cover. Co-present allies need not also act; no regroup, survival contribution or winner causality acceptance.

exposure.scope: Consistent formation inputs and actual changed-teammate team actions on both sides; not ally action, survival contribution or winner causality.

counterSemantics.schedule: self_turn/other_turn identify the PvP candidate before wildlife/equipment arbitration and decision deadline checks; not an executed turn.
counterSemantics.team_queue: Only queues with the watched actor on a side are counted; unrelated encounters are excluded. Counts continue after sample limits.
counterSemantics.arbitration: Only the watched PvP candidate is counted after wildlife/equipment arbitration and deadline checks; selected means dispatch reservation, not an executed attack.
counterSemantics.arbitrationByActionType: Fixed action-type buckets split basic from approach/patrol and other reservations. A selected approach is not a basic attack. One latest-basic sample is retained within the unchanged stage sample cap.
counterSemantics.team_execution: Only the watched queued striker is counted at actual recheck/target/resolve points. performed_no_hp is not a positive HP hit; hp_hit does not establish survival causality.
counterSemantics.changedBuddyAbsence: Snapshot-level facts accumulated across schedule and relevant queues, not per-encounter absence causes or elapsed seconds. actor_absent_runtime_roster and truncated_roster are unavailable comparisons, not positive evidence of buddy absence.

naturalFormation.limits: basic candidate counts are globally returned next-PvP candidates, not every per-actor possibility. approach includes patrol, last-seen tracking and chase; selected is a reservation, not a strike. Team resolution excludes solo fallback. Missing actor/truncated roster categories are unavailable comparisons, not positive buddy-absence evidence. Zero exposure remains a failed comparison; no seed selection, free attacks or relaxed thresholds.
